story.summaryZh: 小红牛车队车手续约表达对车队的骄傲，并对车队成员的信任表示感谢。

story.originalTitle: 🗣️: "I am incredibly proud to continue this journey with Oracle Red Bull Racing, and I would like to thank Chalerm, Mark, and Oliver, the entire T...
story.summaryEn:
🗣️: "I am incredibly proud to continue this journey with Oracle Red Bull Racing, and I would like to thank Chalerm, Mark, and Oliver, the entire Team, and everyone involved for the trust they have placed in the project. 
"What makes this Team special is the way everyone comes together in pursuit of the same goal, and I feel privileged to work alongside such a talented and committed group every day."
#F1 || #RedBullRacing
detailZh:
我非常自豪能够继续与Oracle 红牛 Racing一起踏上这段旅程，并想感谢Chalerm、Mark和Oliver，整个团队以及所有参与项目的人，感谢他们对这个项目的信任。
这个团队之所以特别，是因为每个人都是为了同一个目标而团结在一起，我感到非常荣幸能够每天与这样一群有才华且投入的团队一起工作。
#F1 || #RedBullRacing
detailEn:
🗣️: "I am incredibly proud to continue this journey with Oracle Red Bull Racing, and I would like to thank Chalerm, Mark, and Oliver, the entire Team, and everyone involved for the trust they have placed in the project. 
"What makes this Team special is the way everyone comes together in pursuit of the same goal, and I feel privileged to work alongside such a talented and committed group every day."
#F1 || #RedBullRacing
